83: 				annotationNode.addWarning(flaggedMessage);

85: 				annotationNode.addError(flaggedMessage);

97: 			// behaviour on _OUR_ 'lombok.NonNull'.

101: 				if (primitiveCandidate != null && primitiveCandidate.vartype != null) {

103: 					boolean primitiveType = false;
104: 					if ("boolean".equals(primitiveTypeName)) primitiveType = true;
105: 					else if ("byte".equals(primitiveTypeName)) primitiveType = true;
106: 					else if ("short".equals(primitiveTypeName)) primitiveType = true;
107: 					else if ("int".equals(primitiveTypeName)) primitiveType = true;
108: 					else if ("long".equals(primitiveTypeName)) primitiveType = true;

138: 										compactConstructors = compactConstructors.prepend(md);

142: 						}

238: 					methodRef = maker.Select(methodRef, annotationNode.toName("requireNonNull"));
